Model designation Designation Value Units
Classification C3 C4
Additional marking -
Maximum number of load cell verification intervals nLC 3000 4000
Maximum capacity Emax 100, 250 & 500 kg
Minimum dead load, relative Emin/Emax 0 %
Relative Vmin (ratio to minimum load cell verification interval) Y = Emax/Vmin 15 000
Relative DR (ratio to minimum dead load output return) Z = Emax/(2*DR) 7 820

Input impedance (for strain gauge load cells) RLC 380 ± 20 Ω

Fraction PLC 0.7
Cable length 3 m
Additional characteristics 6- wire
**Note:** The above indentified Type (represented by the sample(s) identified in the OIML Test Report) have been found to comply with the additional national requirements established by the United States (NIST Handbook 44 and NCWM Publication 14) and specified in the following OIML documents: - R60 DoMC-01 Rev, 1, Additional requirements from the United States: Accuracy class III L. - R60 DoMC-02 Rev, 0, Additional requirements from the United States: Marking requirements. **CERTIFICATE HISTORY**
ISSUE NO. DATE DESCRIPTION
